- scripts/persist_orchestrator.py:420-427 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The backward walk that finds `run_start` in `_newest_failure` has no time limit. It stops only at an entry that is not a failure or has a different key, never at the window boundary or at a time gap. `group_failures` line 568 (`episode_ts[gh] = max(items[gh]["newest_ts"], items[owner]["newest_ts"])`) then takes this run start as the episode time, so a same-key failure that has already aged out can set it.
  WHY: Suppose an item is released (max_hours/cooldown or key_changed) and then fails again with the same key K, regrouped under the same owner. Its episode_ts then falls before the old `<!-- AI_PERSIST_GROUPED_V1 key=K owner=10 -->` marker. The poller's jq `created_at >= $ts` check matches the old marker and skips the post. The item is paused again with no fresh comment. This is a regression from the newest_ts behaviour and contradicts the agents.d fragment's statement that "a regrouped item gets a fresh comment once it or its owner has failed again since". All three reviewers rated it MAJOR (mapped to high).
- agents.d/8427-p8-persist-failure-grouping.md:8 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]

The code emits `{owner: [{issue, id, title, key}]}`, and the same bullet later lists `grouped_items` with (`issue`, `id`, `title`, `key`). A matching stale comment at scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:20250 ("paused under it (issue, local id, failure key)") also leaves out `title`.
  WHY: This is a documentation and contract mismatch only, not a runtime defect. Readers get the wrong shape for a field that test_persist_orch_group_switch_on_groups_comments_once_and_hides_members_from_stalls pins (`"title": ""`). Both reviewers rated it NIT (mapped to low).

- scripts/persist_orchestrator.py:_newest_failure, lines 420-427 (run_start = newest_ts; for e in reversed(ordered): if outcome not in GROUP_FAIL_OUTCOMES or failure_key != key: break; ... run_start = min(run_start, t)); used in group_failures at line 568 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The episode time is now the start of the newest unbroken run of same-key failures. The backward walk ignores the age window and the gaps between entries, so the run can reach back to failures from long before the window. Path: item 11 is grouped on K at time T and the marker is posted. Item 11 is released (max_hours/cooldown or key_changed). Item 11 fails with K again while the owner keeps failing with K. On regroup, the run start predates T, the old marker passes `created_at >= $ts`, and the post is skipped.
  WHY: Item 11 is paused again with no comment, even though it produced a new journal entry. This is a regression from newest_ts and contradicts the agents.d fragment ("a regrouped item gets a fresh comment once it or its owner has failed again since"). Suggested fix: track the previous timestamp in the reversed loop and break when prev_t - t > window_s.
- agents.d/8427-p8-persist-failure-grouping.md:line 8, Poller bullet; scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:20250 | severity=NIT | confidence=4

  WHY: Documentation and contract mismatch only. The field is pinned by test_persist_orch_group_switch_on_groups_comments_once_and_hides_members_from_stalls (`"title": ""`). Suggested fix: add `title` in both places.

  PROBLEM: The episode timestamp walks back through every consecutive same-key failure without limiting the walk to the grouping window, so an old same-key failure can set `newest_failure_ts` after it has aged out.

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/persist_orchestrator.py:_newest_failure, lines 420-426 (run_start walk), consumed by group_failures line 568 (episode_ts[gh] = max(items[gh]["newest_ts"], items[owner]["newest_ts"])) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The reversed walk (lines 421-426) has no time limit: it never stops at the window boundary or on a time gap. Path: an item is grouped while its K failure is more than 12 h old. Once the failure ages past the 24 h window it is released as `key_changed`, because line 514 fires before the max_hours check at line 520, so no cooldown is stored. When it fails again with K it is regrouped, but its run start (and often the owner's) still predates the first marker. The jq check `created_at >= $ts` at scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19982-19987 then matches the old marker and skips the post.
  WHY: The item is paused again with no fresh comment, contradicting agents.d/8427-p8-persist-failure-grouping.md line 8. test_group_episode_time_takes_the_owner_newest_failure_when_newer covers only the owner K→K2→K case, so the member-side unbroken run is untested. Suggested fix: break when the gap to the next older entry exceeds window_s, or when t < now - window_s.
